categories.main_business_segments: Robert Half Inc. operates through three primary business segments: contract talent solutions, permanent placement talent solutions, and Protiviti. Contract talent solutions provides temporary and contract professionals across finance and accounting, technology, marketing and creative, legal, and administrative and customer support. Permanent placement talent solutions focuses on full-time placements in similar functional areas. Protiviti is a global consulting subsidiary offering internal audit, risk, business, and technology consulting services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages a proprietary artificial intelligence (AI) engine to match candidates to jobs, enhance lead generation, and optimize client-candidate fit. AI is also used in marketing campaigns and operational efficiency. Protiviti integrates AI into its consulting offerings, including its patent-pending Protiviti Atlas platform, which provides generative AI functionalities for data analysis, translations, and process automation. The company invests heavily in digital platforms, cloud computing, and data analytics to support its service delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Robert Half serves a broad range of clients, including businesses of all sizes, from startups to large global corporations and government entities. Key customer industries include finance, accounting, technology, legal, marketing, creative, and administrative sectors. Protiviti’s consulting services are targeted at organizations seeking expertise in regulatory compliance, risk management, internal audit, digital transformation, and operational improvement.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates in North America, South America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. As of December 31, 2024, contract talent and permanent placement services were delivered through offices in the U.S. and 17 other countries, while Protiviti had offices in the U.S. and 13 foreign countries. The U.S. remains the largest market, accounting for 78% of total revenue in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: Robert Half operates as a downstream service provider, directly connecting skilled professionals with client organizations and delivering consulting services. The company acts as the employer of record for contract talent and provides end-to-end staffing and consulting solutions to its clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continued investment in AI and digital platforms to enhance the client and candidate experience, expansion of specialized talent and consulting offerings, and leveraging proprietary data assets. The company is focused on innovation in AI-driven recruitment, digital transformation, and developing new consulting capabilities, particularly in AI, risk, and compliance. Sustainability and ESG initiatives are also emphasized as part of long-term strategy.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through fees for contract talent placements (billed hourly to clients), permanent placement fees (typically a percentage of the candidate’s annual compensation, paid by the employer), and consulting fees from Protiviti (time-and-materials, fixed-fee, or unit-based engagements). No fees are charged to employment candidates.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The staffing and consulting markets are highly competitive, with major competitors including local, regional, and national staffing firms, as well as the 'Big Four' accounting firms and other global consultancies for Protiviti. Robert Half differentiates itself through its global brand, advanced AI and data analytics, and broad office network, which provide scale and reach beyond most local competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Robert Half reported $5.80 billion in service revenues, a 9.3% decrease from the prior year, with net income of $252 million. The company experienced a decline in both contract and permanent placement revenues due to macroeconomic uncertainty, while Protiviti saw modest growth. The company maintains strong liquidity and a resilient balance sheet, with significant cash reserves and ongoing dividend payments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Robert Half emphasizes its ability to deliver specialized talent quickly and efficiently through advanced AI-driven matching and a global candidate database. The company’s scale, brand recognition, and integrated technology platforms enable high-quality, consistent service delivery. Protiviti’s collaborative consulting approach and ability to blend consulting and staffing resources provide tailored solutions that adapt to clients’ evolving needs.
